after.description: Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
after.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸과 명시적으로 연결된 부위의 축 방향·상대 회전. 카메라 방향·전신 지지 자세·눈의 시선과 구별한다.
excludes: Camera position, body support pose, eye-gaze direction and a scene object facing the frame are not interchangeable.
Standing or an activity alone does not supply a rotation, connected region, angle, axis or reference basis.
Do not infer eyes, a nose, joints or a human torso from the role name or a mechanical subject.
includes: A declared body axis orientation or relative rotation of connected regions, with the actual regions, relation and reference basis stated.
A nonhuman or represented body can qualify on the same literal contract. Actual source conditions and available owner regions still apply.

before.description: Orientation of body axes and relative rotations of connected body regions.
before.description_ko: 신체 축과 부위 간 상대 회전: 카메라 방향·전신 자세와 구별; 눈 방향을 코 방향으로 대신하지 않음
excludes: 카메라 방향·전신 자세와 구별; 눈 방향을 코 방향으로 대신하지 않음
includes: Orientation of body axes and relative rotations of connected body regions.

changes.reason: The generic body-axis contract applies to an explicitly declared body regardless of biology; no rotation is inferred from pose.

after.description: Explicit whole-body posture, support or articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body, without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
after.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸의 명시적 전신 자세·지지·관절 배치. 실제 대상과 몸의 범위를 확인하며 언급하지 않은 신체 부위나 지지 접촉을 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: A rigid object shape, a camera viewpoint or an activity word alone does not establish a whole-body pose.
Relative rotation of body axes, hand articulation, concrete action and rendered motion have separate roles when supported.
Do not turn an unavailable body or limb into a new entity to satisfy a pose.
includes: Explicit standing, sitting, lying or other whole-body posture of a declared human, animal, robot or represented body.
Preserve the actual support and articulated connections when declared. Standing alone does not supply feet, legs, a supporting ground contact or a human body.
Decide effect versus a required existing posture from the whole source; source-specific category and domain conditions remain cumulative.

before.description: Whole-body posture, support and articulation of a declared subject.
before.description_ko: 몸 전체의 지지와 정지 자세: 신체 축 회전·손 모양·행동과 구별; 지지면과 관절 연결 보존
excludes: 신체 축 회전·손 모양·행동과 구별; 지지면과 관절 연결 보존
includes: Whole-body posture, support and articulation of a declared subject.

changes.reason: The whole-body definition must include explicitly standing animals/robots without inventing anatomy or inferring posture from an activity.

after.description: A separately declared animal participant explicitly accompanying an identified primary subject, with the companion relation, count and ownership grounded.
after.description_ko: 명시된 주 대상에 실제로 동반하는 별도 동물 참여자. 주 대상과 동물의 동반 관계·수·소유자를 각각 확인하며 주 대상을 인간으로 한정하지 않는다.
excludes: A lone animal, an animal name, another animal in the background or a generic peaceful mood alone does not establish companionship.
Do not infer pet ownership, species, domestication, affection, physical contact or a new primary subject from the tag.
An animal-only source with no accompanying relation must use its actual subject/action roles instead.
includes: An explicit animal companion relation to the declared primary subject; the primary subject can be human or nonhuman.
Keep animal identity/count, independent owners and any required contact or placement conditions exactly as supported.

before.description: A separately declared animal participant accompanying the primary subject, with count and ownership explicit.
before.description_ko: 주체 곁의 별도 동물 참여자: 주 대상과 동반 소유자 구별; 동물 수·접촉·종 추가 조건을 보존
excludes: 주 대상과 동반 소유자 구별; 동물 수·접촉·종 추가 조건을 보존
includes: A separately declared animal participant accompanying the primary subject, with count and ownership explicit.

changes.reason: An accompanying animal requires an actual relation, while a human primary is not inherent to that relation. Lone animals remain negative.

after.description: Construction, topology, trim or local form of an identified garment, whether worn, displayed, standalone or represented, distinct from anatomy and material identity.
after.description_ko: 착용·전시·단독·묘사된 의복 자체의 구조·연결·트림·국소 형태. 실제 의복 소유자를 확인하며 인체 구조·피부 표식·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Cloth material or an unowned edge alone is not a garment construction detail.
A garment detail does not establish a wearer, anatomy, exposure, fit, material identity or clothing ensemble.
Do not remove any intrinsic source-specific human, adult or domain restriction.
includes: An actual garment-owned seam, cuff, hem, sleeve, trim or construction relation; an independently declared human wearer is not compulsory.
If a wearer, layering relation, support or attachment is required by the source, preserve that specific condition rather than deriving it from the slot.
Separately supported material, texture, fit, layering or state can have their own roles without duplicating the garment.

before.description: Construction, topology, trim and local form owned by the garment, distinct from anatomy and material identity.
before.description_ko: 의복의 구조·부착·트림·국소 형태: 몸 구조·피부 표식과 분리; 재질과 조직을 표현하면 추가 역할 가능
excludes: 몸 구조·피부 표식과 분리; 재질과 조직을 표현하면 추가 역할 가능
includes: Construction, topology, trim and local form owned by the garment, distinct from anatomy and material identity.

changes.reason: A garment-owned construction role must not invent a human wearer for a standalone/represented garment.

after.description: Explicit color and color placement bounded to an identified hair region, wig or represented hair, distinct from scene grading and material identity.
after.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역·가발·묘사된 머리에 한정된 명시적 색과 배치. 장면 색 보정·빛의 색·의복 색·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Illumination color, global image grading, general fur, a colored fiber object or an unowned color word alone is not hair-region color.
Do not infer dye chemistry, natural pigmentation, a wearer, follicles, hairstyle or another body region from the color.
A broader slot contract does not waive an intrinsic source-specific human or adult condition.
includes: A declared hair or wig color on its actual bounded region; a human wearer or natural living hair is not compulsory.
Keep the exact source color, placement, intrinsic subject restrictions and independently required region ownership.

before.description: Color and color placement bounded to the declared hair regions.
before.description_ko: 지정 머리 영역의 색과 배치: 장면 색 보정·의복 색과 분리; 모발 영역에 한정
excludes: 장면 색 보정·의복 색과 분리; 모발 영역에 한정
includes: Color and color placement bounded to the declared hair regions.

changes.reason: Explicit bounded wig color is local appearance, without dye/pigment biology or a compulsory human owner. Intrinsic source restrictions still apply.

after.description: Explicit shape, length, arrangement or strand topology of an identified hair region or wig, separate from its color and material identity.
after.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역이나 가발의 명시적 형태·길이·배치·가닥 연결. 색·재질과 분리하며 자연 모발·가발·묘사된 머리의 실제 소유자를 구별한다.
excludes: A synthetic fiber sheen alone does not supply a hairstyle or a living hair root.
General animal fur, a braided rope, a body-hair region and a hair-color word are not automatically a head-hair arrangement.
Do not introduce a wearer, head, scalp, follicles, hair identity or a new physical strand connection from a style name.
includes: An explicitly declared hair or wig arrangement with its actual owned region and strand continuity.
A standalone wig or represented hair can qualify without inventing a human wearer or biological follicles.
Source-specific wearer/category conditions and existing-region prerequisites remain mandatory.

before.description: Owned hair shape, length, arrangement and strand topology, separate from its color.
before.description_ko: 머리의 형태와 연결 구조: hair_color의 색과 분리; 가발·살아 있는 모발 소유자 구별
excludes: hair_color의 색과 분리; 가발·살아 있는 모발 소유자 구별
includes: Owned hair shape, length, arrangement and strand topology, separate from its color.

changes.reason: Explicit wig topology and represented hair need their actual carrier rather than invented living hair or a wearer; fiber sheen alone remains negative.

after.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
after.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.
includes: A source-declared light pattern or shadow boundary on its actual receiving surface.
Explicit volumetric rays or other spatial light geometry can use their declared spatial region; a physical receiving surface is not compulsory for that meaning.
Preserve the source geometry, carrier and actual light/receiver relation. The source may require additional independently grounded owners.

before.description: Spatial distribution of light, highlights and shadow boundaries on specified receiving surfaces.
before.description_ko: 대상 표면에 생기는 빛무늬와 그림자 경계: 입사 방향과 광원 종류를 대신하지 않음; 무늬의 받는 표면 명시
excludes: 입사 방향과 광원 종류를 대신하지 않음; 무늬의 받는 표면 명시
includes: Spatial distribution of light, highlights and shadow boundaries on specified receiving surfaces.

changes.reason: Actual volumetric geometry needs its declared spatial region rather than an invented receiving surface or scattering medium.

after.description: Selected instant or phase within an explicitly declared human, natural, mechanical or other event, distinct from clock time, a named occasion and inferred chronology.
after.description_ko: 명시된 인간·자연·기계 등 사건 안에서 선택한 순간이나 단계. 하루 시각·행사 명목과 구별하며 사건의 원인·완료·연속 경과를 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: Clock time, season, historical era and the name of an occasion alone.
An inferred preceding cause, unmentioned event, completed outcome or elapsed sequence.
Do not infer rainfall from wetness or a clock time from low tide; a phase requires its explicit source event relation.
includes: Explicit before/after/during relations and selected natural-event phases, including an already declared loading event, rainfall or tide.
Human participation is not required. Existing source conditions and actual event/carrier identity remain mandatory.
A procedure operation or material transformation can additionally have its own role; a selected event phase alone does not supply the operation or transformation.

before.description: Selected instant within an explicitly declared event, distinct from clock time or inferred chronology.
before.description_ko: 사건에서 선택된 한 순간의 위치: 하루 시각·연속 절차와 구별; 이전·이후는 명시된 사건 관계 필요
excludes: 하루 시각·연속 절차와 구별; 이전·이후는 명시된 사건 관계 필요
includes: Selected instant within an explicitly declared event, distinct from clock time or inferred chronology.

changes.reason: Explicit event phases do not require a human; retain actual event relation and original source guards.

after.description: Explicit participation or relational role of a declared participant, whether primary or secondary, without inferring identity, occupation or a new counterpart from appearance.
after.description_ko: 주·보조 구분 없이 이미 명시된 참여자의 참여상·관계상 역할. 외모에서 정체·직업·관계를 추론하거나 역할 이름만으로 상대역을 추가하지 않는다.
excludes: Off-frame placement, a back view and person count belong to their independently supported framing/count roles.
A rival/partner label does not itself create another participant or establish actual identity, occupation, disposition or a performed interaction.
Role truth and tag fit remain separate from effect permission; a prerequisite role cannot authorize a new role or relationship.
includes: A declared participant role can belong to either the primary or another existing participant. The source must identify the actual role carrier and any independently required relation endpoints.

before.description: Explicit role of another participant, not inferred identity, occupation or relationship from appearance.
before.description_ko: 다른 참여자의 명시된 관계상 역할: 오프프레임·등 보임은 framing; 연인·라이벌 관계를 외모에서 추론하지 않음
excludes: 오프프레임·등 보임은 framing; 연인·라이벌 관계를 외모에서 추론하지 않음
includes: Explicit role of another participant, not inferred identity, occupation or relationship from appearance.

changes.reason: Remove accidental primary/secondary viewpoint restriction while preserving the actual carrier, independently needed endpoints and intrinsic human/adult/domain conditions.

after.description: Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
after.description_ko: 명시된 행위 주체와 상대·물체 사이의 구체적 상호 동작. 인간·동물·기계·묘사된 대상을 포함하며 실제 행위와 소유·접촉 관계를 구별한다.
excludes: A role label, co-presence, proximity or an isolated hand pose does not supply a performed interaction.
Do not add a counterpart, helper, contact, tool or action endpoint from a verb category alone.
Do not split one actual self-owned body into two people or merge explicitly distinct participants.
includes: The source explicitly describes the participants or a participant and an object interacting; each endpoint must be independently supported.
Self-directed interaction can address an explicitly owned part or object while retaining its actual part/whole relationship.
A human participant is not compulsory. Intrinsic source conditions, distinctness or part ownership, and actual performed action remain mandatory.

before.description: Concrete interaction between explicitly declared participants or participant and object.
before.description_ko: 둘 이상의 소유자가 연결된 상호 동작: 인간·동물·물건 역할 명시; 관계 이름만으로 새 행위자를 추가하지 않음
excludes: 인간·동물·물건 역할 명시; 관계 이름만으로 새 행위자를 추가하지 않음
includes: Concrete interaction between explicitly declared participants or participant and object.

changes.reason: The already stated human/animal/object interaction meaning must not be restricted to human subjects; actual endpoints and self/other ownership remain explicit.

after.description: Explicit wetness, dampness, dryness or bounded moisture state of an identified physical surface, distinct from surface material, texture and optical sheen.
after.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 물리 표면의 젖음·축축함·건조함 또는 한정된 수분 상태. 재질 정체, 표면 조직, 광택과 구별한다.
excludes: Gloss, reflectivity, color, roughness or texture alone does not prove moisture; moisture alone does not require gloss.
Air humidity, haze and airborne droplets are not surface wetness without an explicit surface relation.
Do not infer rain, sweat-gland activity, immersion, chemical composition, illness, temperature or a wetting cause from wetness alone.
Do not infer garment transparency, cling, a body region, new anatomy or exposure from damp clothing.
Dry humor, dry color treatment and emotional descriptions do not establish physical dryness.
includes: Explicit wet rock, wet fur or a damp forest floor, with an actual surface carrier and scope.

Actual skin or garment moisture can also support an appropriate skin/garment state role when the complete source independently satisfies that role. Share the supported fact; do not create duplicate owners or effects to obtain another tag.
A dry-to-wet boundary preserves its stated spatial scope. Droplet shape, free-liquid geometry and a condensation process need their separately supported facts.
Choose effect, prerequisite or preservation directly from the whole source; the slot name does not supply the mode.

changes.reason: Preserve actual surface moisture and bound skin/garment wet, damp and dry facts without including unrelated skin/garment state.

after.description: Explicit physical temperature state or temperature change of an identified carrier, separate from illumination color temperature, emotional warmth and a sensory proxy.
after.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 대상의 직접 선언된 물리 온도 상태 또는 온도 변화. 빛의 색온도, 정서적 온기, 열감을 연상시키는 단서와 구별한다.
excludes: Lighting warm/cool or Kelvin color temperature, emotional warmth/coldness, and skin warm-color cues alone.
Steam, a red appearance, gloss or a sensory proxy alone does not establish actual temperature or a heating cause.
Naming temperature as a measurement variable without a declared state, value or change does not supply a thermal-state fact.
Do not add heaters, flames, particles, melting, burns, chemical identity, a numeric value or a heat-transfer mechanism from a thermal state alone.
Cooling alone does not establish a phase change. Explicit melting/solidification or a selected transformation stage requires its own source-supported fact.
includes: An explicitly warm cup, hot metal or cold surface; its actual carrier must be identified.
Explicit cooling or heating preserves the actual temperature-change meaning, without inventing its mechanism, rate, endpoint or elapsed sequence.
Preserve a stated number and unit literally when both exist in the source; do not infer measurement certification or convert units.

A selected thermal state is an effect; a separately required existing thermal state is a prerequisite; an explicit preservation instruction keeps that same state. Decide each mode from the whole source.

changes.reason: Preserve explicit physical temperature meanings separately from color, emotional warmth, sensory proxies and inferred thermal causes.

after.description: Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
after.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸과 명시적으로 연결된 부위의 축 방향·상대 회전. 카메라 방향·전신 지지 자세·눈의 시선과 구별한다.

before.description_ko: 의복의 구조·부착·트림·국소 형태: 몸 구조·피부 표식과 분리; 재질과 조직을 표현하면 추가 역할 가능
excludes: 몸 구조·피부 표식과 분리; 재질과 조직을 표현하면 추가 역할 가능
includes: Construction, topology, trim and local form owned by the garment, distinct from anatomy and material identity.

after.description: Explicit color and color placement bounded to an identified hair region, wig or represented hair, distinct from scene grading and material identity.
after.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역·가발·묘사된 머리에 한정된 명시적 색과 배치. 장면 색 보정·빛의 색·의복 색·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Illumination color, global image grading, general fur, a colored fiber object or an unowned color word alone is not hair-region color.
Do not infer dye chemistry, natural pigmentation, a wearer, follicles, hairstyle or another body region from the color.
A broader slot contract does not waive an intrinsic source-specific human or adult condition.
includes: A declared hair or wig color on its actual bounded region; a human wearer or natural living hair is not compulsory.
Keep the exact source color, placement, intrinsic subject restrictions and independently required region ownership.

before.description: Color and color placement bounded to the declared hair regions.
before.description_ko: 지정 머리 영역의 색과 배치: 장면 색 보정·의복 색과 분리; 모발 영역에 한정
excludes: 장면 색 보정·의복 색과 분리; 모발 영역에 한정
includes: Color and color placement bounded to the declared hair regions.

after.description: Explicit shape, length, arrangement or strand topology of an identified hair region or wig, separate from its color and material identity.
after.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역이나 가발의 명시적 형태·길이·배치·가닥 연결. 색·재질과 분리하며 자연 모발·가발·묘사된 머리의 실제 소유자를 구별한다.
excludes: A synthetic fiber sheen alone does not supply a hairstyle or a living hair root.
General animal fur, a braided rope, a body-hair region and a hair-color word are not automatically a head-hair arrangement.
Do not introduce a wearer, head, scalp, follicles, hair identity or a new physical strand connection from a style name.
includes: An explicitly declared hair or wig arrangement with its actual owned region and strand continuity.
A standalone wig or represented hair can qualify without inventing a human wearer or biological follicles.
Source-specific wearer/category conditions and existing-region prerequisites remain mandatory.

before.description: Owned hair shape, length, arrangement and strand topology, separate from its color.
before.description_ko: 머리의 형태와 연결 구조: hair_color의 색과 분리; 가발·살아 있는 모발 소유자 구별
excludes: hair_color의 색과 분리; 가발·살아 있는 모발 소유자 구별
includes: Owned hair shape, length, arrangement and strand topology, separate from its color.

after.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
after.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.
includes: A source-declared light pattern or shadow boundary on its actual receiving surface.
Explicit volumetric rays or other spatial light geometry can use their declared spatial region; a physical receiving surface is not compulsory for that meaning.
Preserve the source geometry, carrier and actual light/receiver relation. The source may require additional independently grounded owners.

before.description: Spatial distribution of light, highlights and shadow boundaries on specified receiving surfaces.
before.description_ko: 대상 표면에 생기는 빛무늬와 그림자 경계: 입사 방향과 광원 종류를 대신하지 않음; 무늬의 받는 표면 명시
excludes: 입사 방향과 광원 종류를 대신하지 않음; 무늬의 받는 표면 명시
includes: Spatial distribution of light, highlights and shadow boundaries on specified receiving surfaces.

after.description: Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
after.description_ko: 명시된 행위 주체와 상대·물체 사이의 구체적 상호 동작. 인간·동물·기계·묘사된 대상을 포함하며 실제 행위와 소유·접촉 관계를 구별한다.
excludes: A role label, co-presence, proximity or an isolated hand pose does not supply a performed interaction.
Do not add a counterpart, helper, contact, tool or action endpoint from a verb category alone.
Do not split one actual self-owned body into two people or merge explicitly distinct participants.
includes: The source explicitly describes the participants or a participant and an object interacting; each endpoint must be independently supported.
Self-directed interaction can address an explicitly owned part or object while retaining its actual part/whole relationship.
A human participant is not compulsory. Intrinsic source conditions, distinctness or part ownership, and actual performed action remain mandatory.

before.description: Concrete interaction between explicitly declared participants or participant and object.
before.description_ko: 둘 이상의 소유자가 연결된 상호 동작: 인간·동물·물건 역할 명시; 관계 이름만으로 새 행위자를 추가하지 않음
excludes: 인간·동물·물건 역할 명시; 관계 이름만으로 새 행위자를 추가하지 않음
includes: Concrete interaction between explicitly declared participants or participant and object.

after.description: Explicit wetness, dampness, dryness or bounded moisture state of an identified physical surface, distinct from surface material, texture and optical sheen.
after.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 물리 표면의 젖음·축축함·건조함 또는 한정된 수분 상태. 재질 정체, 표면 조직, 광택과 구별한다.
excludes: Gloss, reflectivity, color, roughness or texture alone does not prove moisture; moisture alone does not require gloss.
Air humidity, haze and airborne droplets are not surface wetness without an explicit surface relation.
Do not infer rain, sweat-gland activity, immersion, chemical composition, illness, temperature or a wetting cause from wetness alone.
Do not infer garment transparency, cling, a body region, new anatomy or exposure from damp clothing.
Dry humor, dry color treatment and emotional descriptions do not establish physical dryness.
includes: Explicit wet rock, wet fur or a damp forest floor, with an actual surface carrier and scope.

Actual skin or garment moisture can also support an appropriate skin/garment state role when the complete source independently satisfies that role. Share the supported fact; do not create duplicate owners or effects to obtain another tag.
A dry-to-wet boundary preserves its stated spatial scope. Droplet shape, free-liquid geometry and a condensation process need their separately supported facts.
Choose effect, prerequisite or preservation directly from the whole source; the slot name does not supply the mode.
